say:2:1320409001:0.text: So, Madam, have given it any thought? Let me join the Frozen Paw, I'll take a 20% cut of the profits, and we'll be partners.
say:2:1320409001:0.source_cn: 熊妹子，你考虑得怎么样？只要让我入伙白熊旅店，拿两成利...

say:3:1320409002:0.text: Oh, nice try, but the Frozen Paw is my pride and joy, love. You becoming a partner? Well, that's not likely.
say:3:1320409002:0.source_cn: 实话实说吧，矮人兄弟，白熊旅店是我的心血，让你入伙不太可能。

say:4:1320409003:0.text: But how about this? I'll sweeten the deal with an annual bonus, just like the other staff at the inn get during the cozy winter season. A little "thank you" for all your hard work!
say:4:1320409003:0.source_cn: 不过呢，我可以答应让你和旅店里的其他员工一样，每年拿一...

say:5:1320409004:0.text: A staff bonus? Now we're talking! What kind of numbers are we looking at?
say:5:1320409004:0.source_cn: 员工分红……那每年能拿到多少？

say:6:1320409005:0.text:
Since you're a craftsman, let's say 10% of the net profits each year.
But! This has to stay between us. No spilling to my other employees!
say:6:1320409005:0.source_cn: 看在你是工匠的份上，我可以给到净利润的一成。\n——不...

say:7:1320409006:0.text: Huh, only 10%?! Really, Madam? That's barely a scratch.
say:7:1320409006:0.source_cn: 嚯，才一成？！熊妹子，你这就不太厚道了。

say:8:1320409007:0.text: Do you know what a gem of a craftsman you've got here? I bet there are tons of people out there who'd love to work with me!
say:8:1320409007:0.source_cn: 要是换成别人，能得到我这么出色的工匠的帮助，早乐得蹦起...

say:9:1320409008:0.text: Sure, but anyone willing to partner with you is probably just starting out in the business world. Nothing beats an established place like my inn!
say:9:1320409008:0.source_cn: 你这话说的倒是没错。但能许诺给你合伙人职位的，肯定还在...

say:10:1320409009:0.text: Plus, last I checked, I'm the only one in Whiteridge with a license to run a hot springs inn.
say:10:1320409009:0.source_cn: 更何况，白山公国境内，拥有温泉旅店经营许可的只有我一个人哟。

say:12:1320409011:0.text: Hmph, well. That license is useless without my temperature detector. How are you gonna track down any new hot springs without it?
say:12:1320409011:0.source_cn: ……哼，光有许可也不行啊。我要是不肯帮你造温差探测器，...

say:13:1320409012:0.text: Let me remind you, hot springs are quite rare and hard to find. Most are underground, they'll be impossible to detect without one!
say:13:1320409012:0.source_cn: 我好心提醒你一句，地上温泉数量稀少，没那么好找，更多的...

say:14:1320409013:0.text: Alright, alright, let's find some middle ground here.

say:15:1320409014:0.text: I'll bump you up to 13% of the inn's annual profits, but! If I need repairs or a fancy new addition, you'll only charge me for the materials, deal?
say:15:1320409014:0.source_cn: 我每年拿出旅店利润的一成三给你，作为分红。但旅店需要工...

say:17:1320409016:0.text: Make it 15%! And I'll even throw in exclusive rights to the temperature detector, with no extra charge this time!
say:17:1320409016:0.source_cn: 再加一点，一成五！我可以把温差探测器的专用权让渡给你，...

say:18:1320409017:0.text: ... Fine, but I'll need the design specs too. And I expect you to keep them under wraps, sweetheart.
say:18:1320409017:0.source_cn: ……那就再加上探测器的设计图纸！你得保证它不会泄露给任何人。

say:19:1320409018:0.text: Done deal! You can definitely trust me, oho!
say:19:1320409018:0.source_cn: 没问题，我可是很有信誉的！嚯嚯！

say:20:1320409019:0.text: We've got ourselves a lovely agreement, then. I'll draft up the contract once I'm back at the inn.
say:20:1320409019:0.source_cn: 好，那我们就谈妥了。等返回旅店之后我会写一份合同给你。

say:21:1320409020:0.text: Perfect! You're <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s friend, so I trust ya!
say:21:1320409020:0.male: Perfect! You're <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s friend, so I trust ya!
say:21:1320409020:0.female: Perfect! You're <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s friend, so I trust ya!

say:22:1320409021:0.text: By the way, when do you need the temperature detector?
say:22:1320409021:0.source_cn: 对了，我得问一嘴，温差探测器你们什么时候要？

say:23:1320409022:0.text: As soon as possible, of course!

say:24:1320409023:0.text: Oho, well then, you'd better get to rounding up the materials.
say:24:1320409023:0.source_cn: 哦嚯，那你们得抓紧时间去找材料了。

choice_prompt:25:1320409023.text: Oho, well then, you'd better get to rounding up the materials.
choice_prompt:25:1320409023.source_cn: 哦嚯，那你们得抓紧时间去找材料了。

say:26:1320409024:0.text: I got most of 'em! But I'm missing a couple of special items.
say:26:1320409024:0.source_cn: 我这里的材料当然是能用的都会用上，但难免缺少一些特殊的...

say:27:1320409027:0.text: Alright, what materials are you missing?
say:27:1320409027:0.source_cn: 矮人兄弟，现在还缺什么材料？

say:28:1320409028:0.text: Just a log from an <style="highlight">icewreath pine</style> and a <style="highlight">frost crystal</style> from an ice elemental.

say:29:1320409029:0.text: There's icewreath pines up north, and ice elementals just outside of the town. Get moving!
say:29:1320409029:0.source_cn: 镇子北边就有寒轮松树，郊外应该也有不少冰元素。快去快回吧。

choice:25:0:1.text: Don't you have lots of materials?
choice:25:0:1.male: Don't you have lots of materials?
choice:25:0:1.female: Don't you have lots of materials?

say:31:1320409025:0.text: Oh, I meant no labor costs! Free and no charge aren't the same thing.
say:31:1320409025:0.source_cn: 唉，我说的不收费是指手工费，和完全免费还是不一样的。

say:32:1320409026:1.text: Plus, I'm throwing in premium materials here and not asking for a thing.
say:32:1320409026:1.source_cn: 再说了，还有很多贵重材料都得我自己出，我都没说要收这部分钱。

choice:25:1:2.text: Didn't you say this was free?
choice:25:1:2.male: Didn't you say this was free?
choice:25:1:2.female: Didn't you say this was free?
